text: Komatsu Ltd.'s major shareholders, per its own shareholder-information sheet (as of 30 September 2025), are Japanese trust banks and institutions led by 'The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account)' (18.02%) and Custody Bank of Japan (7.15%), plus State Street entities, Nippon Life Insurance and JPMorgan entities; no state or sovereign shareholder is listed.
